subject: Condensed QBR: pipeline deltas, forecast consolidation & account briefs
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Green <samantha@acmehealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@finovate.io>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Condensed QBR: pipeline deltas, forecast consolidation & account briefs

Team —

We have a tight window before the QBR readout next Thursday. Rather than duplicative account decks, please help me assemble a condensed, account-by-account rollup (one pager each) and a single forecast consolidation we can hand to leadership. Key asks: 

- For each account on your book: 1) latest close probability, 2) delta vs last forecast (dollars), 3) top blockers, 4) one-paragraph next-step.
- Put notes in the shared sheet (link below) by EOD tomorrow so I can stitch the consolidated deck on Tuesday.
- Attach any short account brief (single doc/ppt) — no longer than two slides or one page.

I exported the current pipeline (attached CSV) to make it easier to reconcile. If you have a hard commit that changed since the export, flag it in the comments column.

Shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdeQBRsheet
Pipeline export: 2027Q3_QBR_pipeline_export.csv (attached)

Owners: Rishi — ACME Health (Samantha) and Finovate (Tom).
Monica — MidMarket enterprise roster (priority picks).
Marissa — promotional ARR/renewals that feed the top-line adjustment.
Laura — reconcile any cross-book duplications and bookings timeline.

Keep the notes lean — leadership wants a concise readout. If you hit a red flag (security, legal, procurement) tag me and include a suggested escalation step.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027Q3_QBR_pipeline_export.csv

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Condensed QBR: pipeline deltas, forecast consolidation & account briefs

Jasmine —

Thanks, looping back with the ACME notes and a quick ask for Samantha (cc’d): I created a short account brief for ACME and updated the shared sheet. Highlights below: 

- ACME Health (Current ARR impact: $560k) — Probability moved from 40% -> 65% since last forecast; delta +$150k.
- Blocker: Legal needs a data retention clarifying note for Private deployment; expected closure depends on SOC2 evidence package (we have an outstanding evidence request).
- Next step: legal + solutions sync on Tuesday; I proposed a canary pilot to accelerate procurement.

Attached: ACME_account_brief_v2.docx (one page).

Samantha — can you confirm procurement timelines and whether the SOC2 package on the link below is sufficient? If not, what additional artifacts will speed approval?

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Condensed QBR: pipeline deltas, forecast consolidation & account briefs

Rishi / Jasmine —

Thanks for the brief. Quick update from procurement: we reviewed the SOC2 snapshot and it looks generally good, but our compliance team needs a clarifying note around retention of PHI-derived embeddings and a diagram of network egress controls for the Private option. Can your security team send that? If we get it this week we can keep the July procurement window and likely close in early August.

Also, for forecast purposes, please mark ACME as a best-case commit for August and a probable close for Sept if we don't receive the retention note this week.

Appreciate the concise brief — attaching our procurement checklist for reference.

Best,
Samantha
VP, InfoSec & Procurement
Acme Health

Attachments: acme_procurement_checklist.pdf

Thanks — quick coordination note: I've created a tabbed section in the shared sheet for legal/security blockers. Rishi, please add the exact doc names we need and I will ping Security to produce the retention note + architecture diagram. Monica — please prioritize any accounts with similar concerns and flag them in column H ("security blocker").

I will be stitching a 6-slide consolidated deck (one-slide summary, 4 slides of account deltas + one slide of risk/asks). Goal: give execs a concise picture and one ask list. I'll push a draft deck link by Tuesday 10:00 PT.

Link to sheet again: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdeQBRsheet

-J

Jasmine / team —

I updated the MidMarket tab with two priority changes that materially affect the Q3 forecast: 

1) Halberd Analytics — moved from 25% -> 50% after successful pilot; ARR delta +$220k. Added short note in the sheet (row 42).
2) Meridian Health — renewal timing pushed to Oct; mark as runway risk (delta -$180k).

I've attached a short one-page note for Meridian that outlines the procurement cadence and recommended escalation to customer success. Also added a comment on ACME to indicate they requested a network diagram (Samantha’s note).

Team —

Draft consolidated deck is here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0Bqbr_deck_link (QBR_consolidated_deck_v1.pptx attached). I pulled the numbers from the sheet and annotated the primary deltas on slides 2–5. Quick notes: 

- Top-line adjustment: +$190k uplift to Q3 best-case vs last forecast after incorporating Rishi and Monica updates.
- Risks called out: ACME (legal hold), Meridian (renewal timing), and one promotional renewal (Marissa to confirm).
- Asks for execs: 1) approval to route security resources for ACME evidence note; 2) sign-off to treat Halberd as a mid-quarter uplift in best-case.

Please review slide notes and add any corrections directly in the deck comments or the sheet. I need final confirmations by end of day Tuesday so I can lock the deck for Wednesday exec review.

Thanks —
Jasmine
